summary: Nimbus Group AB (Publ) designs, manufactures, and markets leisure motorboats in the Nordics, Europe, North America, and internationally. It also provides spare parts and accessories; aftermarket services; and winter storage services. The company offers its products under the Nimbus, Alukin, Aquador, Bella, Falcon, Flipper, EdgeWater, and Paragon Yachts brand names. Nimbus Group AB (Publ) was founded in 1968 and is based in Västra Frölunda, Sweden.
